claim: A GuardDuty administrator account can have up to 50,000 member accounts through AWS Organizations, including members added by invitation; the number cannot exceed the member accounts in the organization. Before December 20, 2023 the maximum was 10,000.
question: How many member accounts can a GuardDuty administrator manage through AWS Organizations?

qualifiers.condition: depends on the AWS Organizations member account quota

evidence.quote:
| Member accounts | 50,000 | The maximum number of member accounts associated with a administrator account through AWS Organizations. This includes member accounts that are added to the organization by invitation.
This default value depends on your current quota for member accounts in AWS Organizations. The number of member accounts in GuardDuty that are added through AWS Organizations can't exceed the number of member accounts in your organization. For information about number of AWS accounts in an organization, see [Maximum and minimum values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_reference_limits.html#min-max-values) in the *AWS Organizations User Guide*. |

| [GuardDuty supports 50,000 member accounts through AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_organizations.html) | A delegated GuardDuty administrator can now manage a maximum of 50,000 member accounts through AWS Organizations. This also includes a maximum of 5000 member accounts that associated with the GuardDuty administrator account by invitation. | December 20, 2023 |

| [GuardDuty supports 10,000 member accounts through AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_organizations.html) | A GuardDuty administrator account can now manage a maximum of 10,000 member accounts through AWS Organizations. This also includes a maximum of 5000 member accounts that associated with the GuardDuty administrator account by invitation. | June 29, 2023 |

note: d031. Raised to 50,000 on 2023-12-20 (was 10,000 from 2023-06-29); see guardduty-org-members-raised-to-50000.
